trigger_phrase: who long for death and do not obtain it, digging for it as for treasures,

trigger_phrase: who become overjoyed if they should attain it?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Death is rest to a man, for God shut in against him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For before my food, groaning comes to me, and I weep, being held fast by fear.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For fear which I pondered came upon me, and what I dreaded met me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I neither had peace nor was quiet nor rested, but wrath came to me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And taking up the matter, Eliphas the Thaimanite says,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Were many times spoken to you in distress? But strength of your words, who will bear?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For you instructed many and encouraged weak hands.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And those failing you raised up by words, and upon knees without strength you put courage.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But now pain comes upon you and touches you, and you were hasty.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Is not your fear foolishness, and your hope, and innocence of your way?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Remember then, who being pure perished? Or when did true men perish root and all?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In the way I saw, those plowing improper things and those sowing them will reap pains for themselves.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: By command of the Lord they will perish, and by breath of his wrath they will be wiped out.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Strength of lion, voice of lioness, and boast of dragons were quenched.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ant-lion perished for not having food, and lion cubs abandoned one another.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But if any true word happened in your sayings, none of these evils would ever have met you. Will not my ear receive strange things from him?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But fears and sound of night, fear falling on men,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: dread met me and trembling, and greatly my bones shook together.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And a spirit came upon my face, and my hairs and flesh shuddered.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I stood up and did not recognize; I looked, and there was no form before my eyes, but only a breeze, and I was hearing a voice:
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: What then? Shall mortal be pure before the Lord, or shall a man be blameless by his works?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If he does not trust in his servants, and against his angels he devised something crooked,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: then those dwelling in houses of clay, from which we also are from the same clay, he struck like a moth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And from morning until evening they no longer exist, because they were not able to help themselves. They perished.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For he breathed on them and they dried up. They perished for not having wisdom.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But call, if anyone will hear you, or if you will see any of the holy angels.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For anger kills the fool, and jealousy kills the wandering one.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But I saw fools throwing down root, yet immediately their way of life was eaten up.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let their sons be far from deliverance, and let them be beaten at doors of inferiors, and there will be no one rescuing.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For what they gathered, righteous men will eat, but they themselves will not be delivered from evils. Let their strength be drained away.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For toil will not come out from the earth, nor will pain sprout up from the mountains.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But man is born for toil, and young vultures fly to the heights.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Yet I will petition the Lord, and I will call on the Master of all.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He does great and unsearchable things, glorious and extraordinary things beyond number,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: giving rain upon the earth, sending water upon what is under heaven,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: making lowly ones into height, raising up those who were lost,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: turning aside counsels of the crafty, and their hands will never do what is true,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: the one catching wise men in their cunning, and overthrowing counsel of the twisted,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: in daytime darkness will meet them, and at noon they will grope as in night.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But let the weak perish in war, and let the powerless come out from hand of the mighty.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And let there be hope for the powerless, but mouth of the unrighteous be stopped.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But blessed is man whom the Lord corrected; do not reject discipline of the Almighty.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For he causes pain and again restores. He struck, and his hands healed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Six times from necessities he will deliver you, and in the seventh evil will not touch you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In famine he will rescue you from death, and in war he will free you from hand of iron.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: From scourge of the tongue he will hide you, and you will not fear evils coming.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You will laugh at unjust and lawless men, and you will not fear from wild beasts,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: for wild beasts will be at peace with you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then you will know that your house will be at peace, and dwelling of your tent will never go wrong.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will know that your seed is many, and your children will be like all-herbage of the field.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will come to the grave like ripe grain harvested in its season, or like heap of threshing floor gathered at its time.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Behold, these things we searched out. These are what we heard. But you, know for yourself if you did anything.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And taking up the matter, Iōb says,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If only someone might weigh my anger, and lift my pains together in balance.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For now it would be heavier than sand of seashore; but, as it seems, my words are worthless.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For arrows of Lord are in my body, whose fury drinks up my blood; whenever I begin to speak, they stab me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For surely wild donkey does not cry for nothing, unless seeking grain; nor will ox bellow at manger while having fodder.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will bread be eaten without salt? Or is there taste in empty words?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For my soul cannot cease, for I see my foods as stench, like smell of lion.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If only my request might come, and Lord might give my hope.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let Lord begin and wound me; but in end let him not destroy me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let my city be grave, upon whose walls I leaped; upon it I will by no means spare myself, for I did not lie about words of holy God.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For what strength have I, that I keep enduring? Or what time remains for me, that my soul keeps bearing?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Is my strength strength of stones, or is my flesh bronze?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Or was I not trusting in him? But help has gone far from me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Mercy renounced me, and visitation of Lord overlooked me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: My near ones did not regard me; like failing torrents, or like wave they passed me by.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Those who feared me before have now fallen upon me, like snow or frozen ice.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: As things melted when heat came, what they were was not recognized.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus I too was abandoned by all; I perished and became homeless.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Look at ways of Thaimanites, paths of Sabaeans, those who look intently.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They will owe shame, those trusting in cities and riches.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But now you too fell upon me without mercy, so that seeing my wound you were afraid.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For what? Did I ask anything from you, or do I need some of your strength?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: So as to save me from enemies, or rescue me from hand of rulers?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Teach me, and I will be silent; if I have gone astray, show me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: As it seems, words of truth are worthless, for I do not ask strength from you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Nor will your reproof stop me with words, for neither will I endure sound of your speech.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Only because you fall upon orphan, and spring against your friend.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But now, looking into your faces, I will not lie.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Sit down then, and let there not be injustice; and again come together with righteous judgment.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For there is no injustice on my tongue; does not my throat ponder understanding?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Is not life of man on earth a trial, and his life like that of day-laborer?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Like servant fearing his master and having attained shade, like hired man waiting for his wage,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: so I too inherited empty months, and nights of pains were given me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If I lie down, I say, When day? and when I rise again, When evening? And I am full of pains from evening until morning.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: My body is mixed with rottenness of worms; I melt clods of earth, scraping off the discharge.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: My life is lighter than speech, and has perished in empty hope.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Remember then that my life is breath, and my eye will no longer return to see good.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Eye of one seeing me will not look on me; your eyes are on me, and I am no longer.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Like cloud cleansed away from heaven, if man goes down to Hades, he will certainly not come up again.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Nor will he ever return again to his own house, nor will his place know him anymore.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But therefore neither will I spare my mouth; I will speak in distress, opening bitterness of my soul while hard pressed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Am I sea or dragon, that you set a guard over me?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If I say, My bed will comfort me, and my couch will bear my complaint for me,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: then you frighten me with dreams and terrify me with visions.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You will free my soul from breath, and my bones from death.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For I will not live forever, that I should be patient. Depart from me, for my life is empty.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: What is man, that you magnified him, or that you set your mind on him,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: or make visitation of him until morning, and judge him for rest?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Until when will you not let me be, nor release me until I swallow my spittle in pain?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If I sinned, what can I do to you, knower of minds of men? Why did you set me as your accuser? And I have become burden to you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And why did you not make forgetfulness of my lawlessness and cleansing of my sin? For now I will depart into earth, and seeking me early, I am no more.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And taking up the matter, Baldad the Sauchite says,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: How long will you speak these things, wind of many words from your mouth?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will Lord do injustice in judging, or will maker of all disturb what is right?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If your sons sinned before him, he sent them away in hand of their lawlessness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But you, rise early toward Lord, begging Almighty.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If you are pure and true, he will hear your petition and restore to you dwelling of righteousness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then your first things will be few, but your last things beyond counting.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ask indeed former generation, and search out race of fathers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For we are of yesterday and do not know; for our life on earth is shadow.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will not these teach you and tell you, and bring out words from their heart?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Does papyrus flourish without water, or will reed rise high without drink?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: While still on its root and not yet cut, before any herb drinks, does it not dry up?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: So then will be end of all who forget Lord, for hope of ungodly will perish.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For his house will be uninhabited, and his tent will turn out to be spider's web.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If he lean on his house, it will not stand; if he take hold of it, it will not endure.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For it is moist under sun, and from its decay its shoot will come out.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: It sleeps upon gathering of stones, and in midst of pebbles it will live.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If place swallow it up, it will deny it: You have not seen such things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For such is overthrow of ungodly, and from earth another will sprout.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For Lord will by no means reject blameless one, but will not receive any gift of ungodly.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Yet he will fill mouth of true ones with laughter, and their lips with confession.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But their enemies will clothe themselves with shame, and dwelling of ungodly will not be.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And taking up the matter, Iōb says,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If he should wish to enter judgment with him, he will not answer him one word out of thousand.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For he is wise in mind, mighty and great. Who, having hardened himself against him, endured?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He who ages mountains, and they do not know, overthrowing them in anger.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He who shakes what is under heaven from foundations, and its pillars totter.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He who says to sun, and it does not rise, and seals up stars.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He who stretched out heaven alone and walks as upon ground on sea.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He who makes Pleiad and Evening Star and Bear and chambers of south.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He who does great and unsearchable things, glorious and astonishing things without number.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If he pass over me, I will not see; if he go by me, I would not know.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If someone turn him away, who will turn him back? Or who will say to him, What have you done?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For he turned away wrath; under him sea-monsters beneath heaven were bowed down.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And if he should hear me, will he discern my words?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For even if I am righteous, he will not hear me; I will plead with my judge.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And if I call and he answers, I do not believe that he has heard my voice.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let him not rub me out in storm-cloud; he made my shatterings many for nothing.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For he does not let me take breath, but filled me with bitterness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If it is matter of strength, he is strong; but in judgment, who will withstand him?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Even if I am righteous, my mouth will act ungodly; if I am blameless, I will turn crooked.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For even if I did act ungodly, I do not know in my soul; only this, that my life is taken away.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore I said, wrath destroys both great man and ruler.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For worthless men are remarkable in death, but righteous are laughed to scorn.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For earth is given into hands of ungodly; he covers faces of its judges. But if not he, who is it?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: My life is lighter than runner; they fled and did not know.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Or is there track of way for ships, or of eagle flying and seeking food?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If then I say, I will forget my speaking, stooping with face I will groan,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I shudder in all my limbs, for I know that you will not leave me innocent.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Since I am ungodly, why then did I not die?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For if I wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with purity,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: sufficiently you dipped me in filth, and my garment loathed me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For you are not man like me, against whom I will answer, that we might come together into judgment.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If only there were mediator of us, and reprover, and one hearing between both.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let him take his rod away from me, and let his fear not whirl me about.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then I would not fear, but speak, for I do not know myself so.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Weary in my soul, groaning, I will let my words go upon him; I will speak bitterness of my soul while hard pressed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will say to Lord, Do not treat me as ungodly; teach me why you judged me thus.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Is it good to you if I act unjustly, that you reject works of your hands, but give heed to counsel of ungodly?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Do you look as mortal looks, or see as man sees?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Is your life human, or your years those of man,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: that you searched out my lawlessness and tracked down my sins?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For you know that I did not act ungodly, but there is none rescuing from your hands.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Your hands formed me and made me; then changing, you struck me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Remember that you molded me like clay, and you turn me back into earth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Did you not milk me out like milk and curdle me like cheese?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: With skin and flesh you clothed me, and with bones and sinews you wove me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Life and mercy you set with me, and your oversight guarded my spirit.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Holding these things within yourself, I know that you can do all things, and nothing is impossible to you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If I sin, you watch me, and from lawlessness you did not make me innocent.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If I am ungodly, woe to me; if I am righteous, I cannot lift myself up, for I am full of dishonor.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For I am hunted like lion for slaughter, and again changing, you destroy me terribly.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Renewing my examination against me, you used great wrath toward me and brought trials upon me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Why then did you bring me out from womb? Would that I had died and eye had not seen me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I would have become as if I had not been. Why then was I not carried from belly to grave?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Is not time of my life small? Let me be, that I may rest a little,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: before I go from where I will not return, into land dark and gloomy,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: into land of eternal darkness, where there is no light, nor seeing of life among mortals.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And taking up the matter, Sophar the Minaian says,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will one who says many things also answer back? Or does wordy man think himself righteous, blessed though born of woman and short-lived?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Do not become abundant in words, for there is no one answering you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For do not say, I am pure in works and blameless before him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But how might Lord speak to you and open his lips with you!
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then he would declare to you power of wisdom, because they will be double to what is with you. And then you will know that what came to you from Lord matches what you sinned.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will you find track of Lord, or reach to ends of what Almighty made?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Heaven is high; what will you do? Deeper than things in Hades; what do you know?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Longer than measure of earth and broader than sea.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If he overturn all things, who will say to him, What did you do?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For he knows works of lawless men, and seeing wrongs he will not overlook.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But man drifts vainly in words, and mortal born of woman is like desert donkey.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For if you set your heart pure and stretch out hands toward him,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: if any lawless thing is in your hands, put it far from you, and let not injustice lodge in your dwelling.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For then your face will shine like pure water, and you will strip off filth and by no means fear.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will forget toil, like wave that passed by, and you will not be alarmed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And your prayer will be like morning star, and life will rise for you from midday.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will be confident because there is hope for you; and out of care and anxiety peace will appear for you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For you will be at rest, and none will make war on you; and many changing course will entreat you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But salvation will fail them, for their hope is destruction, and eyes of ungodly will melt.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And taking up the matter, Iōb says,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then you are men indeed, and wisdom will die with you?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But I too have heart like you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For righteous and blameless man became object of mockery.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For appointed time was prepared for him to fall under others and for his houses to be plundered by lawless men.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Yet let no one, being evil, trust that he will be innocent; all who provoke Lord, is there not examination for them too?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But now ask beasts, if they will tell you, and birds of heaven, if they will report to you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Or tell earth, if it should explain to you, and fish of sea will recount to you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Who does not know in all these that hand of Lord made these things,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: if not that in his hand is soul of every living thing and breath of every human?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For throat discerns words, and palate tastes foods.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In much time is wisdom, and in long life knowledge.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: With him are wisdom and power; with him counsel and understanding.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If he throws down, who will build? If he shuts against men, who will open?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If he hold back water, he will dry earth; if he let it loose, he ruined it by overthrowing.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: With him are might and strength; with him knowledge and understanding.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Leading counselors away captive, he drove judges of earth mad.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Setting kings on thrones, he bound belt around their loins.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Sending priests away captive, he overthrew rulers of earth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Changing lips of faithful men, he takes away understanding of elders.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Pouring dishonor on rulers, but healing humble ones.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Revealing deep things from darkness, and bringing shadow of death into light.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Leading nations astray and destroying them, spreading out nations and guiding them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Changing hearts of rulers of earth, he led them astray in path they did not know.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let them grope darkness and not light, and let them wander like drunkard.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Behold, my eye has seen these things, and my ear heard them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: What you know, I also know; I am not less understanding than you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But indeed I will speak to Lord, and if he wishes I will reason before him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But you are unjust physicians and healers of evils, all of you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If only you would be silent, and it would turn out to be wisdom for you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Hear correction of my mouth, and give attention to judgment of my lips.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Do you not speak before Lord, and utter deceit before him?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will you shrink back, and become judges yourselves?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: It will indeed be good if he searches you out, if in doing all things you attach yourselves to him?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Yet he will surely reprove you, even if in secret you admire faces.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will not his terrors whirl you, and fear from him fall upon you?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Your boasting will turn out equal to ashes, and body to clay.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Be silent, so I may speak, and let wrath rest from me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Taking my flesh in my teeth, I will put my soul in my hand.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If Mighty One should lay hand on me, since he has begun, yet I will speak and reason before him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And this will turn out for me into salvation, for deceit will not enter before him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Hear, hear my words, for I will declare with you listening.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Behold, I am near my judgment; I know that I will appear righteous.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For who is he that will contend with me? Then I would be silent and expire.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But use two things toward me; then I will not hide from your face.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Hold back your hand from me, and let not your fear terrify me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then you will call, and I will answer you; or you will speak, and I will give you reply.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: How many are my sins and lawless acts? Teach me what they are.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Why do you hide from me and count me your opponent?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will you fear leaf moved by wind, or oppose me as grass carried by breath?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For you wrote bitter things against me and laid on me sins of youth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You put my foot in restraint, and watched all my works, and came up to roots of my feet.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I grow old like skin-bag, like garment eaten by moth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Mortal born of woman, short-lived and full of wrath.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Like flower blooming he fell off; he fled like shadow and will not stand.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And on this one you made account, and this one you caused to enter judgment before you?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For who will be clean from defilement? No one.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Even if his life is one day on earth, and his months beyond number are with you, you set him a time and he will not pass it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Depart from him, that he may rest and take pleasure in his life like hired man.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For there is hope for tree: if it be cut down, it will bloom again, and its shoot will not fail.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If its root should grow old in earth and its stump die in rock,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: by scent of water it will blossom and make harvest like young plant.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But man, having died, is gone; and mortal, having fallen, is no more.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For in time sea grows scarce, and river, having deserted, dried up.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: So man, having fallen asleep, will certainly not rise until heaven is stitched together. They will not be awakened from their sleep.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If only you had kept me in Hades and hidden me until your wrath ceased, and set me a time in which you would remember me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For if man die, will he live again? Having completed days of my life, I wait until I become again.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then you will call, and I will listen to you. Do not reject works of your hands.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You counted my practices, and none of my sins will escape you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You sealed my lawless acts in purse, and marked if in anything I transgressed unwillingly.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Yet mountain falling will collapse, and rock will grow old out of its place.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Waters wore stones smooth, and waters flooded dust of earth, and you destroyed hope of man.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Pushing him to end, he is gone; you set his face and sent him away.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If his sons become many, he does not know; if they become few, he is not aware.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But his flesh grieved, and his soul mourned.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And taking up the matter, Eliphas the Thaimanite says,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will wise man give answer of understanding's spirit, and fill belly with pain?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Reproving with words that are not needed, and speeches with no profit.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Indeed you cast off fear and brought such words to completion before Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You are guilty by words of your mouth, nor did you discern words of mighty men.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Your own mouth will reprove you, not I; your lips will testify against you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For were you first of men to be born, or were you fixed in place before hills?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Did you hear ordinance of Lord, and did wisdom reach to you alone?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For what do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that is not also with us?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Both gray-haired and aged men are among us, heavier in days than your father.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For little things in which you sinned you were chastised greatly; you spoke excessively beyond measure.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: What did your heart dare, and what did your eyes bring on?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: That you burst out wrath against Lord and brought out such words from your mouth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For what is mortal, that he will be blameless? Or how will one born of woman be righteous?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: If he does not trust his holy ones, and heaven is not clean before him,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: how much more abominable and unclean is man, drinking injustice like drink.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But I will declare to you; hear me. What things I indeed have seen, I will tell you,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: what wise men will say and did not hide from their fathers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: To them alone earth was given, and foreigner did not come upon them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: All life of ungodly is in care, and numbered years are given to tyrant.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Fear is in his ears; when he thinks he is at peace, destruction will come on him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let him not believe he will turn back from darkness, for he is already appointed into hands of iron.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He is appointed for vultures as food; he knows in himself that he remains for corpse, and dark day will whirl him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Necessity and distress will hold him, like commanding general falling in front rank.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because he raised hands against Lord and stiffened neck against Lord Almighty.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He ran against him in insolence, in thickness of hump of his shield.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because he covered his face in his fat, and made collar upon thighs.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let him lodge in deserted cities, and enter uninhabited houses; what those men prepared, others will carry off.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He will by no means grow rich, nor will his possessions remain; his shadow will not fall on earth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Nor will he escape darkness; wind will wither his shoot, and his flower will fall off.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let him not believe he endures, for empty things will turn out for him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: His cutting-down will be completed before its time, and his shoot will not flourish.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let him be harvested like unripe grape before its time, and fall off like flower of olive.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For witness of ungodly is death, and fire will burn houses of gift-takers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In belly he will receive pains, and empty things will turn out for him, and his belly will bear deceit.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And taking up the matter, Iōb says,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I heard many such things, all of you comforters of evils.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For is there not order to windy words? Or what troubles you that you answer?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I too would speak like you, if only your soul lay in place of mine; then I would exult over you with words and shake head against you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But let there be strength in my mouth; I will not spare movement of my lips.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For if I speak, I will not ease the wound; if I keep silent, how much less will I be wounded?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But now he made me worn out, rotten and foolish.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He seized me for witness; it became so, and my lie rose up in me, answering against my face.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.
